title: A Periodic Long-Time Boltzmann--Grad Limit in Every Fixed Dimension $d\ge 4$
summary: We prove a periodic long-time Boltzmann--Grad limit for hard spheres in every fixed spatial dimension $d\ge4$. Under the assumptions of the main theorem, the rescaled $s$-particle correlations converge in $L^1$ to the corresponding tensor-product Boltzmann profile at rate $\varepsilon^{1/(400d)}$, uniformly for $1\le s\le|\log\varepsilon|$ and $0\le t\le t_{\rm fin}$. In particular, when the activity and weighted solution bounds are fixed, $t_{\rm fin}=O(\log|\log\varepsilon|)$.
